title: Training #4 — 30-Year Seasonal Water-Cycle Change Dataset
purpose: Train and evaluate temporal Earth-observation representations for detecting reproducible surface-water, river, wetland, cryosphere and terrain-linked change while preserving provenance, uncertainty and environmental-consequence boundaries.

time_policy.current_year_2026: context/evaluation only until both requested seasonal windows are complete
time_policy.rule: Never describe 1990-2026 as a 30-year interval. TEST 001 keeps its full historical context while the reproducible training core uses exactly 30 complete calendar years.

target.pack_meaning: A pack is a provenance-linked multi-date/multi-source observation bundle for one AOI, not one independent image.
target.distribution_note: This is a deliberate balanced sampling policy for representation learning, not a claim about the natural percentage of Earth's surface occupied by these classes.

test_001_anchor.training_policy: The methodology and scientific guardrails may inform curriculum design, but exact TEST 001 AOI pixels and outcome labels are excluded from training and validation. They are reserved for independent evaluation.
test_001_anchor.lesson: Learn to distinguish observed water loss, observed water gain elsewhere, stable/no-recovery cases, seasonal variability and unknown cause.

season_policy.tropics: Do not falsely label local hydroclimatic seasons as spring/autumn. Derive two matched local hydrological windows from an official precipitation climatology and store the actual window labels and method.
season_policy.polar: Use matched shoulder-season windows when illumination and sensor physics permit; otherwise use SAR/validated ice products and record optical_unavailable instead of substituting a fake clear optical scene.
season_policy.comparison_rule: Prefer same-AOI same-season comparisons across years. Intra-year spring-to-autumn packs are a separate seasonal-response task.

temporal_pairing.long_baseline_example: 1996 versus 2025 is the endpoint comparison of the 30 complete-year archive.

historic_core.rule: Do not upsample 30 m Landsat and claim new 10 m detail.

recent_detail.rule: Use as recent detail context; keep resolution metadata explicit when comparing to Landsat.

regional_terrain_context.higher_resolution: NASADEM/SRTM 30 m where scientifically suitable; COP-DEM-GLO-30 only when current access rights authorize it.
regional_terrain_context.rule: Coarser context may be resampled for tensor alignment but must retain native-resolution provenance.

scene_quality.selection: Search the seasonal window and choose the best valid observation using official QA/cloud metadata, not visual preference alone.
scene_quality.fallback: If no scientifically usable optical observation exists, record UNKNOWN/optical_unavailable and use SAR as complementary evidence where appropriate.

historic_surface_reflectance: USGS/NASA Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance
water_change_cross_checks: European Commission JRC Global Surface Water yearly/monthly history as an official derived product
all_weather_radar: NASA JPL OPERA DSWx-S1 where its validation scope applies
JAXA public ALOS/PALSAR/PALSAR-2/JERS-1 products for independent L-band context
terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 only when authorized
dynamic_water_height: NASA/CNES SWOT RiverSP water-surface elevation, slope, width, area and discharge estimates from 2022 onward
hydrometeorology: Copernicus Climate Change Service ERA5-Land for long-period meteorological context
NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO for regional terrestrial-water-storage context
hydrography: official/public basin, river and drainage products with explicit licence/provenance; HydroSHEDS may be used where its terms and resolution are suitable

terrain_height_features.purpose: Connect the project's terrain/elevation flags to reproducible hydrological context.
terrain_height_features.ui_bridge: Every displayed height flag should be traceable to the DEM/product, native resolution, vertical datum when known and derivation method.

learning_targets.label_policy: Derived water-change classes are DERIVED_VALUE or MODEL_ESTIMATE unless independently validated. Training loss is never environmental ground truth.

candidate_features: increasing water extent or validated water-surface elevation
spill_risk_policy.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer imminent flooding from elevation or water-area change alone.
spill_risk_policy.validation: Calibrate false-alert and missed-event rates on geographically held-out historical flood/non-flood cases before public risk use.

paleochannel_evidence: published geology/hydrography when public and authoritative
experimental_track.intervention_rule: The system may evaluate counterfactual water-routing scenarios but must not present a real river diversion as a ready-to-build recommendation.
required_consequence_matrix: effects on communities using public aggregate evidence only
experimental_track.required_question: What evidence would falsify this restoration/diversion hypothesis, and what field/hydrological checks are required before any intervention is considered?

geographic_split.priority: Split by watershed/geography before random pixel split.
geographic_split.neighbor_leakage_rule: Do not place spatially overlapping or immediately adjacent windows from the same event/AOI in both train and holdout.

pack_provenance_required: source URL or reproducible catalogue identifier
